mapper.select: SELECT p.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM preset_item pi WHERE pi.preset_id = p.id) AS item_count FROM preset p WHERE p.lora_id = #{loraId} ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.id
SELECT p.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM preset_item pi WHERE pi.preset_id = p.id) AS item_count, (SELECT l.name FROM lora l WHERE l.id = p.lora_id) AS lora_name FROM preset p WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM preset WHERE lora_id = #{loraId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace WHERE preset_id = #{presetId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) FROM preset WHERE lora_id = #{loraId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO preset (lora_id, name, status, note, sort_order) VALUES (#{loraId}, #{name}, #{status}, #{note}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE preset SET name = #{name}, status = #{status}, note = #{note}, updated_at = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE id = #{id}
